```{r}
harvest <- function(mod_obj, param, alpha = 0.05) {
  
  # param should be a named vector: names = predictor names (e.g. "X1", ..., "X20")
  stopifnot(!is.null(names(param)))
  
  # coefficient table
  est_raw <- as.data.frame(summary(mod_obj)$coefficients)
  est_raw$param <- row.names(est_raw)
  
  # drop intercept
  est <- est_raw %>%
    filter(param != "(Intercept)") %>%
    transmute(
      variables = param,
      estimate  = `Estimate`,
      pval      = `Pr(>|t|)`
    )
  
  # confidence intervals
  CIs_raw <- as.data.frame(confint.default(mod_obj, level = 1 - alpha))
  CIs_raw$param <- row.names(CIs_raw)
  names(CIs_raw)[1:2] <- c("LCL", "UCL")
  
  CIs <- CIs_raw %>%
    filter(param != "(Intercept)") %>%
    transmute(
      variables = param,
      LCL, UCL
    )
  
  # base result frame
  res <- tibble::tibble(
    variables     = names(param),
    true_values   = as.numeric(param),
    true_non_zero = as.integer(true_values != 0)
  ) %>%
    left_join(est, by = "variables") %>%
    left_join(CIs, by = "variables") %>%
    mutate(
      selected = as.integer(!is.na(estimate)),
      signif   = as.integer(selected == 1 & pval < alpha),
      covered  = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(LCL) & !is.na(UCL) ~ as.integer(LCL <= true_values & true_values <= UCL),
        TRUE ~ NA_integer_  # no CI if not selected
      )
    )
  
  res
}
```

```{r}
simfunc <- function(n, rho, alpha_en = 0.5, alpha_cov = 0.05) {
  
  # true betas
  param <- c(1/6, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6, rep(0, 15))
  
  # simulate data
  dat_obj <- gen_data(
    n      = n,
    p      = 20,
    p1     = 5,
    beta   = param,
    family = "gaussian",
    corr   = "exchangeable",
    rho    = rho
  )
  
  dat <- data.frame(y = dat_obj$y, dat_obj$X)
  x   <- as.matrix(dat_obj$X)
  y   <- dat_obj$y
  
  # name param to match columns of X (e.g. "X1", ..., "X20")
  names(param) <- colnames(dat_obj$X)
  
  # saturated model
  sat_model <- lm(y ~ ., data = dat)
  
  out_list <- list()
  
  ## 1. p‑value backward (alpha = 0.05)
  pval_redux <- step(
    sat_model,
    direction = "backward",
    trace = 0,
    k = qchisq(1 - 0.05, df = 1)
  )
  tmp <- harvest(pval_redux, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "PVAL"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["PVAL"]] <- tmp
  
  ## 2. AIC
  AIC_redux <- step(
    sat_model,
    direction = "backward",
    trace = 0,
    k = 2
  )
  tmp <- harvest(AIC_redux, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "AIC"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["AIC"]] <- tmp
  
  ## 3. BIC
  BIC_redux <- step(
    sat_model,
    direction = "backward",
    trace = 0,
    k = log(n)
  )
  tmp <- harvest(BIC_redux, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "BIC"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["BIC"]] <- tmp
  
  ## 4. LASSO (alpha = 1)
  cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = 1, standardize = TRUE)
  
  # lambda.min
  coef_min <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min")
  sel_min  <- rownames(coef_min)[as.numeric(coef_min) != 0]
  sel_min  <- setdiff(sel_min, "(Intercept)")
  if (length(sel_min) > 0) {
    lasso_min_mod <- lm(
      as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(sel_min, collapse = " + "))),
      data = dat
    )
  } else {
    lasso_min_mod <- lm(y ~ 1, data = dat)
  }
  tmp <- harvest(lasso_min_mod, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "LASSO_min"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["LASSO_min"]] <- tmp
  
  # lambda.1se
  coef_1se <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.1se")
  sel_1se  <- rownames(coef_1se)[as.numeric(coef_1se) != 0]
  sel_1se  <- setdiff(sel_1se, "(Intercept)")
  if (length(sel_1se) > 0) {
    lasso_1se_mod <- lm(
      as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(sel_1se, collapse = " + "))),
      data = dat
    )
  } else {
    lasso_1se_mod <- lm(y ~ 1, data = dat)
  }
  tmp <- harvest(lasso_1se_mod, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "LASSO_1se"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["LASSO_1se"]] <- tmp
  
  ## 5. Elastic net (alpha = 0.5)
  cv_en <- cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = alpha_en, standardize = TRUE)
  
  # lambda.min
  coef_en_min <- coef(cv_en, s = "lambda.min")
  sel_en_min  <- rownames(coef_en_min)[as.numeric(coef_en_min) != 0]
  sel_en_min  <- setdiff(sel_en_min, "(Intercept)")
  if (length(sel_en_min) > 0) {
    en_min_mod <- lm(
      as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(sel_en_min, collapse = " + "))),
      data = dat
    )
  } else {
    en_min_mod <- lm(y ~ 1, data = dat)
  }
  tmp <- harvest(en_min_mod, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "EN_min"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["EN_min"]] <- tmp
  
  # lambda.1se
  coef_en_1se <- coef(cv_en, s = "lambda.1se")
  sel_en_1se  <- rownames(coef_en_1se)[as.numeric(coef_en_1se) != 0]
  sel_en_1se  <- setdiff(sel_en_1se, "(Intercept)")
  if (length(sel_en_1se) > 0) {
    en_1se_mod <- lm(
      as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(sel_en_1se, collapse = " + "))),
      data = dat
    )
  } else {
    en_1se_mod <- lm(y ~ 1, data = dat)
  }
  tmp <- harvest(en_1se_mod, param = param, alpha = alpha_cov)
  tmp$method <- "EN_1se"
  tmp$n      <- n
  tmp$rho    <- rho
  out_list[["EN_1se"]] <- tmp
  
  do.call(rbind, out_list)
}
```

```{r}
spin <- function(nsim = 500, profile) {
  stopifnot(nrow(profile) == 1)
  
  res <- vector("list", nsim)
  for (iter in seq_len(nsim)) {
    tmp <- simfunc(n = profile[,"N"], rho = profile[,"rho"])
    tmp$iter <- iter
    res[[iter]] <- tmp
  }
  do.call(rbind, res)
}

```

```{r}
profiles <- expand.grid(
  rho = c(0, 0.35, 0.7),
  N   = c(250, 500)
)

n_profiles <- nrow(profiles)
plan(multisession, workers = n_profiles)
set.seed(12345)

# choose nsim based on your SE target
Ep  <- 0.5
SEr <- 0.01
nsim <- ceiling(Ep * (1 - Ep) / SEr^2)

system.time({
  simres_list <- future_lapply(
    1:n_profiles,
    function(i) spin(nsim = nsim, profile = profiles[i,]),
    future.seed = TRUE
  )
})

simres <- do.call(rbind, simres_list)
plan(sequential)

```

```{r}
summary_metrics <- simres %>%
  group_by(n, rho, method, iter) %>%
  summarise(
    tpr = mean(selected[true_non_zero == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    fpr = mean(selected[true_non_zero == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    bias = mean(
      estimate[true_non_zero == 1 & selected == 1] -
        true_values[true_non_zero == 1 & selected == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    coverage = mean(covered[true_non_zero == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    type1 = mean(signif[true_non_zero == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    type2 = mean(1 - signif[true_non_zero == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(n, rho, method) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(tpr, fpr, bias, coverage, type1, type2),
      \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

vars_selected <- simres %>%
  group_by(n, rho, method, iter) %>%
  summarise(num_selected = sum(selected), .groups = "drop")

```{r}
make_scenario_table <- function(n_val, rho_val) {
  summary_metrics %>%
    filter(n == n_val, rho == rho_val) %>%
    select(method, tpr, fpr, bias, coverage, type1, type2) %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title = paste0("Results for n = ", n_val, ", ρ = ", rho_val)
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(
      columns = c(tpr, fpr, bias, coverage, type1, type2),
      decimals = 3
    )
}

# Example:
make_scenario_table(250, 0.35)
```
